title: RAW / Illuminatus Portal Ontology
description: Schema vocabulary for the Illuminatus and Robert Anton Wilson knowledge portal. It separates entity classes, relation types, evidence status, and card/page expectations so content can be generated progressively.

entity_classes.label: Work
entity_classes.description: A book, trilogy, essay collection, play, anthology, or other authored text.

entity_classes.label: Person
entity_classes.description: A historical person, collaborator, influence, critic, editor, or public interlocutor.

entity_classes.label: Character
entity_classes.description: A fictional character or factional persona appearing in Illuminatus-related fiction.

entity_classes.label: Concept
entity_classes.description: An interpretive idea, term, model, or recurring theme.

entity_classes.label: Place
entity_classes.description: A real, fictional, or hybrid location used by the narrative atlas.

entity_classes.label: Routine
entity_classes.description: A recurring textual, comic, paranoid, initiatory, or Burroughs-like sequence that can be analyzed as scripted repetition.

entity_classes.label: Scene
entity_classes.description: A bounded narrative unit tied to characters, places, motifs, and passages.

entity_classes.label: Plot Arc
entity_classes.description: A thematic or narrative reading path such as Detective Story, Discordian Initiation, or Conspiracy Cartography.

entity_classes.label: Esoteric Correspondence
entity_classes.description: A Thelemic, Qabalistic, tarot, magical, Discordian, or secret-society reference treated with evidence and interpretive caution.

entity_classes.label: Countercultural Movement
entity_classes.description: A scene, tendency, or milieu such as psychedelic counterculture, Discordianism, Beat afterlife, or underground publishing.

entity_classes.label: Psychedelic Concept
entity_classes.description: A consciousness, altered-state, or Leary-adjacent model tracked as a portal concept.

entity_classes.label: Publication Venue
entity_classes.description: A magazine, zine, press, website, or archive venue.

entity_classes.label: Interview / Audio / Video
entity_classes.description: An interview, lecture, recording, transcript, or audiovisual archive item.

entity_classes.label: Relationship / Edge
entity_classes.description: A typed connection between two portal entities.

evidence_statuses.description: Directly supported by a source currently in hand.
A strong inference from available sources, but not yet directly anchored.
A scholarly reading or critical claim rather than a bare bibliographic fact.
A known slot awaiting more source confirmation.

entry_layers.card: Short browsing record used by overview pages, search results, relation drawers, and map popups.
entry_layers.page: Long-form essay record used for close reading, scholarly synthesis, and source notes.
entry_layers.source_packet: Smallest available source excerpt or bibliographic note needed to enrich or audit one entity.

editorial_constraints: Distinguish fact, inference, interpretation, and esoteric association.
Do not flatten RAW's ambiguity into simple doctrinal belief.
Track irony, masks, initiatory play, paranoia, counterculture rhetoric, and model agnosticism.
Use card-first, page-second, source-packet-last context loading.
